Siding · Cape Cod, MA

Siding repair & installation built for Cape Cod weather.

Cedar shingle, vinyl and fiber cement — repaired or replaced as a full wall system, with rot fixed properly and a clean finish. Free on-site estimate.

Get a free estimate (508) 566-1618

Why it matters

Siding is a system. Every layer matters.

Good siding isn't just what you see. It's solid backing, insulation where it applies, a weather-resistive barrier, and clean transitions at every window, door, corner and trim line.

We repair the weak points, rebuild the transitions, and seal the details — so water stays out and the wall looks sharp for years.

  • Stops water intrusion at the source
  • Rot repaired before it spreads — not patched over
  • Straight lines, aligned courses, clean trim details
  • Daily cleanup and a protected job site

FAQ

Siding questions, answered.

What types of siding do you work with?

Cedar shingle, vinyl and fiber cement — plus the trim, fascia and soffits around them.

Can you match my existing siding?

When possible. If it's discontinued or has aged, we'll show you the closest option.

Can you repair one section instead of replacing everything?

Often, yes. Many homes need a targeted repair. We'll explain when replacement is the better long-term choice.

What if there's hidden rot behind the siding?

We document it and repair the compromised backing or sheathing before closing up.

How long do siding repairs take?

It depends on scope and weather. You'll get a timeline after the evaluation, before work starts.
